description: Clean a CSV ($0.005 USDC): give an https url or inline csv (max 1 MB / 20k rows). Trims whitespace, optional case rules, dates to ISO 8601, lowercases emails, normalizes phone digits, merges or flags exact + fuzzy duplicate rows on key_columns. Returns cleaned CSV text + JSON report (rows in/out, dupes, columns changed). Deterministic, no AI. As is, no warranty. Nothing stored. As is, no warranty. Nothing stored.

csv.description: Inline CSV text instead of url (max 1 MB).

date_columns.description: Columns to convert to ISO 8601 (default auto).

date_order.description: Order for ambiguous numeric dates (default mdy).

dedupe.description: merge (default) keeps first row and fills its blanks; flag adds _duplicate_of_row; none.

default_country_code.description: Country code for e164 when missing (default 1).

fuzzy.description: Also match near-duplicates (case/punctuation/accents, small typos). Default true.

fuzzy_threshold.description: Similarity 0.5-1 for typo matches (default 0.92; 1 = normalized-equal only).

has_header.description: First row is a header (default true).

key_columns.description: Columns used to detect duplicates (default all).

max_groups.description: Max duplicate groups listed in report (default 50, max 500).

phone_columns.description: Phone columns (default auto by header name).

trim_whitespace.description: Trim and collapse whitespace in every cell (default true).

url.description: Public https URL of a CSV (max 1 MB).

name: data-cleanup
